The script does not download or execute arbitrary code, exfiltrate data, modify system configuration, or perform any suspicious network activity beyond checking for the latest version. The use of `curl` and `jq` to parse JSON from the GitHub API is expected and benign in this context.

The destination of the API request (`api.github.com`) is legitimate and directly related to the declared upstream. No obfuscation, unexpected file modifications, or dangerous commands are present. This script assists in routine package maintenance and poses no security threat.
</details>
